issue.title: S3 · Four matching words to spot interception
issue.body:
### Summary
A key swapped during setup can't be noticed today (T-S3).
### Acceptance (the attack fails)
Both screens show the same 4 words. A swapped key makes them differ and both are warned.

### Update (PR #50)
Optional: behind "Check this device" on a device's name. Never shown in a quick share (PRD S3, UC7).
